## Change

Describe the user-visible change and its scope.

## Verification

Record actual tests and generated-profile checks. State remaining limitations.
Do not include private evidence, credentials, or invented review approvals.

## Checklist

- [ ] Public package inventory is reviewed.
- [ ] Existing project files and local edits are preserved.
- [ ] Documentation matches implemented behavior.
- [ ] Commits use the contributor's real identity and applicable DCO signoff.
